Long dark hair frames an oval face with a rounded hairline showing moderate temporal recession and high forehead placement. The soft-arched eyebrows are of medium thickness with downward-angled lateral tails, set above almond-shaped eyes with an upward slant, positive canthal tilt, and moderate double-lid creases. The nose has a straight dorsum and rounded tip with moderate alar flare, while the mouth exhibits balanced lip fullness and a moderately defined cupid's bow. The chin is rounded and the skin texture is smooth, with the subject captured in a direct sideways gaze and neutral expression.
